entries.name: Lor'themar Theron
entries.note: Referenced in chapter3 (dispatch addressee; Convocation) but not on page. Not mentioned in chapter4.

entries.name: Jaina Proudmoore
aliases: Jaina (Lyriel, from chapter4; Arthas; Sylvanas's interior from chapter5)

entries.name: Antonidas
entries.note: Referenced in Jaina's thoughts in chapter4 (the hat, 'would have had a fit', the test of method); not on page. Chapter6: named by Jaina to the sergeant and Arthas ('Did Antonidas finally throw you out?'), and as the reader of her write-ups; not on page.

entries.name: Neral
entries.note: Chapter4: absent; Jaina half-turns to tell her something and finds nobody; two empty places at the back of the line. Chapter6: absent; the 'two places nobody filled' behind the four.

entries.name: Millhaven survivor girl (unnamed)
entries.note: Chapter4: recalled in Jaina's memory (her words about everybody coughing at the well, sweet breath, 'cheaper than Mister Hollis').

entries.name: The old carter (unnamed)
entries.note: Not mentioned in chapter4. Chapter5: recalled in Sylvanas's memory only. Chapter6: named aloud by Sylvanas to Jaina ('an old carter going north over the bridge') after the tally-man's farewell; referenced only.

entries.name: The fourth ranger (unnamed)
entries.note: Chapter4: absent (north with Neral).

entries.name: Millhaven villagers (named in the girl's account)
Willem Brask
entries.note: Chapter7: his loft sacking square (carried by Sylvanas) and the jar under his floor recalled; not on page.

entries.name: Tam
entries.note: Dead in chapter4. Chapter7: recalled in Sylvanas's thoughts (the trained standing of the men in Fenner's yard; the boy on the hoist who bit open his collar).

entries.name: Garran
entries.note: Chapter6: recalled in Jaina's thoughts (eating bread sops in milk twice a day all summer; 'eating it out of a bowl with a spoon').

entries.name: Hob, Nan and Ellen (the bakehouse family)
Mother Haw
aliases: the woman at the end of Cooper's Lane

entries.name: The young man with the cart (the newer grain seller)
entries.note: Never on page. Chapter6: recalled by Jaina ('A young man with a cart had sold flour two coppers cheaper on the measure at the sick village, four loads of it, the last a fortnight before they came') and as one man who could not have driven every load in Corley's book.

entries.name: Corley (crossroads depot clerk)
entries.note: Chapter6: Corley's book recalled in Jaina's thoughts.

entries.name: River-depot overseer (unnamed)
entries.note: Alive, fled south with his wife. Do not bring back (plan). Chapter6: his stove and answers recalled in Jaina's thoughts.

entries.name: Depot-country witnesses (miller, hamlet woman, ostlers, clerks, keepers, brown-coat men)
aliases: the two men in brown coats

entries.name: Lord Barov
entries.note: Chapter6: named by Arthas ('That's Barov.' / 'He'd sue me for the rest of it, and he'd talk for an hour first.') and by Jaina ('I'm saying nothing about Lord Barov'). Not on page.

entries.name: Prince Arthas
entries.note: First on page in chapter6 (Strahnbrad camp).

entries.name: The granary tally-man (unnamed)
entries.note: Leaves Andorhal on foot; sends the party to Captain Havel; says 'May the stars keep your road'.

entries.name: Strahnbrad camp soldiers (sergeant, boy, lieutenant, officers, Silver Hand)
The Garrow family (old Garrow, his daughter, her two boys)
entries.note: Dead before the chapter; reported by Arthas.

entries.name: Captain Havel (militia, Andorhal)
entries.note: Chapter6: name only. Chapter7: on the page at the militia post (harried, territorial, city-first captain; steers the lanes; not narrated as cult-paid).

entries.name: Corin
entries.note: Young Kirin Tor inspection-office clerk-mage; tracks copied yard marks; opens the sample room.

entries.name: The Andorhal cult cell (the eight sentries, the runner, the masked crew)
entries.note: Eight at Fenner's (incl. the runner), five masked at Kett's, three more going up Hurdle Lane at the bell.

entries.name: Andorhal gate and yard people
entries.note: Gate clerk and guards on page; yard-reeves, Kett, Holt's boy, the magistrate and the factor named offstage by Havel.
